title: Towards Formalising Schutz' Axioms for Minkowski Spacetime in Isabelle/HOL
relevance: Mechanizes an axiomatic event/path/betweenness presentation of Minkowski spacetime, including temporal order and explicitly layered locales; directly relevant to assumption-sensitive relativity.
limits: Read arXiv full text sections on locale/axiom encoding and reported results; also inspected AFP current generated outline at source-outline level, but not underlying theory/session or independent replay. Publication is a formalization report, not an ontological result.
authors: Richard Schmoetten, Jake E. Palmer, Jacques D. Fleuriot
version: arXiv:2108.10868 (v1 paper); AFP current generated outline dated 2026-02-06
locator: Paper Sections 3–5; AFP generated outline pages 9–10, 27–28, 68 expose locale hierarchy and path-density assumption
assumptions: Schutz event/path axioms encoded in Isabelle/HOL locales; paper notes the symmetry formalization chooses pointwise event invariance, stronger than a possible setwise reading; density is isolated in a separate locale.
conclusion: Paper/outline report mechanized temporal-order and geometric consequences of Schutz's axioms; not a proof that actual spacetime has a preferred global time or that an ontology follows.
proof_status: Authors report checked Isabelle proofs. Generated outline statements read; not built/replayed here.
dependencies: AFP session lists Util, TernaryOrdering, Minkowski, TemporalOrderOnPath; full dependency/admission closure not audited.
